description: Search the OEIS using its query syntax: plain words, "quoted phrases", comma-separated terms, prefixes (keyword:, author:, name:, comment:, formula:, program:, xref:, id:), | for OR, and a leading - to exclude. Returns up to 10 summaries per page. For identifying a sequence from its terms, oeis_identify_sequence is the direct route.

query.description: OEIS query, sent as written. Examples: keyword:core fibonacci; author:Sloane; "Catalan numbers" (a quoted phrase); 1,2,5,14,42. oeis_list_reference topic search_syntax lists the prefixes and operators.

sort.description: Result order: relevance (default), number (ascending A-number), created (newest entry first), or modified (most recently edited first).

start.description: Result offset: 0, 10, … 100 (OEIS shows at most 110 results per query). Pass nextStart from the previous page.

name: oeis_search_sequences

effectiveQuery.description: The query as OEIS parsed it (lowercased upstream), e.g. seq:1,2,5,14,42.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `pacer_shed`: The oeis.org request queue would exceed its wait budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: oeis.org answered HTTP 429 Too Many Requests and retries within the call did not clear it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextStart.description: Pass as start for the next page; absent on the last reachable page.

notice.description: Guidance: why nothing matched, how to narrow the query, or how to reach the next page.

results.description: Matching sequences on this page, in the applied order.

aNumber.description: A-number, e.g. "A000108"; pass it to oeis_get_sequence for the full entry.

author.description: Author line as OEIS records it, written by OEIS contributors; absent when the entry has none, as on a reserved or recycled A-number.

firstIndex.description: The index n of the first term (the first number of offset); absent with offset.

keywords.description: Keyword flags such as nonn, core, tabl; oeis_list_reference topic keywords decodes them.

legacyIds.description: Legacy book numbers, e.g. ["M0692", "N0256"]; absent on entries that have none, and when OEIS sends no readable edit line.

modified.description: When the entry was last edited, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-09-23T16:08:09-04:00"; absent when OEIS sends no readable edit time.

name.description: Sequence name, written by OEIS contributors.

offset.description: Offset "i,p": i is the index n of the first term, p the 1-based position of the first term with |a(n)| > 1. Absent on a reserved or recycled A-number (keyword allocated or recycled).

terms.description: Data-line terms as exact decimal strings, signs kept.

url.description: Sequence page on oeis.org; cite it wherever the entry is reused.

start.description: The result offset of this page as OEIS served it; below the requested start when that start was past the last result (OEIS then serves the last page).

totalCount.description: Total rows: the match count OEIS reported, or for outgoing cross-references the number of distinct A-numbers the entry names.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than this page shows.

title: Search OEIS Sequences
